versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Fire-walking smiths who keep reheating a few units: Heat grows a unit each turn but burns it in fights.
Build one masterpiece, quench Heat for stats now, never cool and burn the enemy, or grow back from injuries.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Clarified the cards players couldn't read: Ember-Slinger now says your units keep their Heat, Spitter counts Shield-blocked burns.
"Reforge twice" became "Reforge once more" so stacking reads right, and Mother Atra now pays for gaps next to Hot units.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
